operations.summary: Read the account and its operational state.
Mint a workspace API key whose value is returned once.
Revoke a workspace API key.
List workspace API key metadata.
Read the automatic top-up policy.
Replace the automatic top-up policy.
Read the prepaid balance of an organization.
Create a hosted billing portal session.
Mint a download grant for an issued statement.
Read one immutable issued statement.
List issued statements, newest first.
Create a hosted top-up checkout.
Request cancellation of a central operation.
Read one central durable operation.
List central durable operations for one organization.
One bounded read that fills the dashboard shell.
Exchange a provider authorization code for a browser session.
Close the browser session the caller presented.
Begin the CLI device-authorization flow.
Approve or deny a pending device authorization.
Exchange an approved device code for an account token.
Redeem every pending invitation addressed to the caller's verified email.
Invite a person to the organization.
List the memberships of an organization.
Create an organization whose creator becomes owner.
Read one organization.
List organizations the caller belongs to.
Create a region-pinned workspace.
Admit the global workspace-deletion operation.
Read one workspace.
List workspaces the caller can reach.
Read one BYOK provider-credential binding.
Register a dedicated BYOK provider credential; carries plaintext once.
Revoke a BYOK provider-credential binding.
List BYOK provider-credential binding metadata.
Request cancellation of a regional operation.
Read one regional durable operation.
List regional durable operations.
Delete one registered workspace file.
Mint a download grant for a registered workspace file.
Read one registered workspace file.
List registered workspace files.
Replace one registered workspace file.
Cancel current work and return the session to idle.
Create an eight-hour multi-turn session.
Irreversibly delete the session and session-scoped user content. Independent registered workspace files remain.
Re-stat, re-hash, and close an exact live-file download after SDK verification.
Open one exact-version live file directly from the retained generation, auto-resuming it.
Close an abandoned live-file descriptor, auto-resuming the same generation.
Read one raw exact-version range directly from the retained generation.
List the exact live generation, auto-resuming that same generation when suspended.
Stat one live path without following a symlink, auto-resuming the same generation.
Verify every part and atomically publish one live file in the same generation.
Create a resumable upload in the exact live generation, auto-resuming it when suspended.
Abort a partial upload, auto-resuming the same generation to remove its temporary bytes.
Read resumable live-upload state, auto-resuming the same generation.
Put one exact logical part directly into the retained generation.
Read session metadata, including automatic lifecycle state, or its minimal deletion tombstone.
Send text and start the session's next work, automatically resuming the same suspended generation.
List complete sealed messages in immutable seal-visibility order.
Resume the same retained generation to idle.
Suspend an idle session while retaining its exact generation; cancel active work first.
Mint a five-minute download grant for one immutable OTLP protobuf segment.
List immutable AEX-generated OTLP protobuf segments for a session.
Permanently destroy compute and live files while retaining metadata and sealed messages.
List sessions in the workspace.
Abort a staged upload.
Complete a staged upload.
Stage a large registered-resource value.
Mint presigned PUT grants for the named parts.
Query rated usage for this workspace.
Read the workspace this credential is pinned to.
Read one effective workspace safety limit.
List the effective workspace safety limits. The registry is closed and complete, so the whole set is one page and no continuation is ever minted.

ids.description: A person's role inside one organization.
A pending invitation to join an organization.
A region-pinned execution and content boundary.
Workspace API key metadata; never the secret.
A durable conversation and its workspace.
One internal execution agent, root or subagent.
A pending or resolved tool approval.

limits.description: Largest tool result admitted into the next model context.
Root-plus-subagents concurrently materialized in one session.
Largest aggregate byte size of registered workspace files materialized synchronously before session creation returns ready.
Largest number of registered workspace files selected for synchronous session creation.
Revisioned Brain planner and structural ceilings pinned when a session is created.
Revisioned per-message duration and Brain budget ceilings pinned when a session is created.

Largest accepted collection page in items and serialized bytes.

scopes.description: Read the caller's account and operational state.
Decide the caller's own device authorizations and close their own browser session.
List and read organizations the caller belongs to.
Redeem invitations addressed to the caller's own verified email.
Mint and revoke workspace API keys.
Create checkouts, portal sessions and top-up policy.
Request cancellation of a durable operation.
Read the current workspace and its effective limits.
Create sessions, send messages, and cancel, suspend, resume or terminate a session.
Access live session files, automatically resuming the same suspended generation.
Read registered opaque workspace files and mint their download grants.
Replace and delete registered opaque workspace files and stage uploads.
Read dedicated BYOK provider-credential binding metadata.
Register and revoke dedicated BYOK provider credentials.

deletionScheduledAt.description: When unfunded content is scheduled for deletion. Published and permanently absent: this is the regional content lifecycle's fact and that authority does not exist yet.

minimumRestoreCents.description: Smallest top-up that restores service. Present exactly when `reason` is `top_up_required`; the other three holds have no paying remedy, and naming an amount for them would be a false one.

retentionFundedUntil.description: How long retained content stays funded. Published and permanently absent: storage is billed monthly and unfunded storage is enforced through the account pause, so no authority owns this instant yet.

message.description: A human message; never a provider body.

operationId.description: The durable operation this failure belongs to.

retryable.description: Whether an identical retry can succeed.

amountCents.description: How much each automatic top-up adds.

thresholdCents.description: Balance at or below which a top-up is attempted.

amountCents.description: How much each automatic top-up adds.

thresholdCents.description: Balance at or below which a top-up is attempted.

data.description: The encoded bytes. A larger payload goes through the upload surface.

vcpus.description: Virtual CPUs; fractional at the smaller shapes.

sha256.description: Hash of the stored payload bytes.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the stored payload in bytes.

accounts.description: Current operational state for each organization in this snapshot.

session.description: The bearer credential; hold it in a cookie the browser will not hand to script.

code.description: The single-use authorization code the redirect returned. It is redeemed exactly once and never retried: a code the provider may already have consumed cannot be re-presented.

codeVerifier.description: The RFC 7636 PKCE verifier the browser held in its own cookie for this plane's origin. Possessing it is what proves the redirect belongs to the browser that started this sign-in: a cross-site forgery carries somebody else's `state` and cannot present a verifier that hashes to it.

state.description: The `state` the provider echoed back. It is the RFC 7636 S256 challenge of `codeVerifier`, and the exchange refuses any request where it is not.

expiresAt.description: When the device code stops working.

userCode.description: The short code the user types.

verificationUriComplete.description: The same page with the code prefilled.

userCode.description: The short code the device displayed.

decision.description: What was recorded; never differs from the request.

scopes.description: The scopes the device asked for, so the page can name what it granted.

accountToken.description: The bearer token; store it, never log it.

range.description: The signed range, when the grant is partial.

url.description: The signed URL; never printed by the CLI.

effective.description: The effective value at the time of the request.

measured.description: What the request would have required.

attempted.description: What this request would have added.

apiUrl.description: The regional host to reissue against.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer to the offending position.

target.description: The exact, unnormalized link text for a symlink.

resolvedAt.description: When it was accepted, revoked or expired.

memberships.description: One membership per invitation redeemed by this call, created or raised to the invited role. Bounded by the same 100 the acceptance transaction reads.

expiresAt.description: When the descriptor is closed if the client abandons it.

generationId.description: The only generation that may answer.

partCount.description: How many ranged parts the SDK must fetch; zero for an empty file.

parts.description: Expected part ranges and hashes, ascending.

version.description: Opaque identity binding the bytes and bounded stat evidence.

workspaceAccess.description: Which generation answered and whether it resumed.

sha256.description: The whole-file SHA-256 the SDK recomputed.

version.description: The exact version returned at initiation.

offset.description: The first byte in the whole file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 the SDK must verify before retaining the part.

path.description: Subtree to list; defaults to the root.

recursive.description: Whether to descend; defaults to false.

expiresAt.description: The provider-generation expiry; never later than eight hours after launch.

generationId.description: The only generation that may accept it.

partCount.description: How many logical parts the file has; zero for an empty file.

workspaceAccess.description: Which generation answered and whether it resumed.

sizeBytes.description: The exact complete file size, at most five GiB.

offset.description: The first byte in the complete file.

deadline.description: An earlier absolute deadline. It must be in the future and cannot exceed the session's remaining `expiresAt`/drain fence.

maxSpendCents.description: The current-message spend ceiling. Omission means 1000 cents; the platform does not reserve account funds.

text.description: The complete user text. The MVP bound keeps Brain's canonical admission record below its 32,768-byte inline journal ceiling with envelope overhead; staged message bodies are deferred.

session.description: The session with current activity populated.

id.description: The operation identity minted by the caller.

sessionId.description: The owning session, when there is one.

terminalAt.description: When the record reached a terminal status.

detail.description: Customer-safe detail, when the domain produced it.

retryable.description: Whether the same operation step may be retried.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token; absent on the last page.

callerRole.description: What the calling principal may do here.

version.description: The exact version; ranges are rejected.

returnUrl.description: Where to return when the user is done.

fingerprint.description: A one-way fingerprint of the key material.

provider.description: Which provider the credential is for.

apiKey.description: The provider key; write-only, never returned.

provider.description: Which provider the credential is for.

sha256.description: Hash of the canonical value document, not of the payload. The payload's own hash is `value.content.sha256`.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the canonical value document in bytes, not of the payload.

mountPath.description: Where it is mounted in the guest.

sha256.description: Hash of the canonical value document.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the canonical value document in bytes.

mountPath.description: Where it is mounted in the guest.

catalogRevision.description: The signed model-catalog release that qualified this provider and model pair.

activeDeadline.description: The internal bounded deadline for the active message.

activeMaxSpendCents.description: The effective current-message spend ceiling: the request value, or 1000 when omitted.

activeMessageId.description: The user message whose work is active. Absent while no message is active.

createdAt.description: When metadata was created; this does not determine the provider lifetime.

expiresAt.description: Exactly 28,800 seconds after `launchedAt`; suspension never extends it.

idleSince.description: When the session most recently became idle.

launchedAt.description: When the provider generation first launched.

suspendAt.description: When an idle session will automatically suspend; exactly 180 seconds after `idleSince`.

suspendedAt.description: When this exact generation most recently suspended.

terminatedAt.description: When compute and live files were permanently destroyed.

changed.description: Whether work was active and got cancelled.

providerCredentialId.description: The exact BYOK binding; the platform never guesses between bindings.

idleSuspendAfterSeconds.description: Idle sessions automatically suspend after exactly three minutes.

maximumLifetimeSeconds.description: The provider generation expires exactly eight hours after `launchedAt`.

resumeOnLiveFileAccess.description: A live-file request automatically resumes this same suspended generation.

resumeOnMessage.description: A message automatically resumes this same suspended generation.

activeMessageId.description: The active user message, when any.

expiresAt.description: When the provider generation's eight-hour lifetime ends.

changed.description: Whether the retained generation was resumed.
Whether the session transitioned to suspended.

url.description: The signed S3 URL; never printed by the CLI.

createdAt.description: When S3 accepted the immutable object.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact protobuf bytes.

changed.description: Whether live compute or files existed and were destroyed.

amountCents.description: The amount to add, in whole cents.

partCount.description: How many parts the object needs.

etag.description: The entity tag the store returned.

headers.description: Headers the caller must replay verbatim.

sizeBytes.description: The exact Content-Length to be signed.

operationId.description: The operation, when attributable. Never populated by `usage_query`, as `sessionId`.

sessionId.description: The session, when attributable. Never populated by `usage_query`: that route answers from a coarse face that carries no session identity, and its absence is honest rather than an omission.

source.description: Which authority produced the facts. One of the `UsageAuthority` identifiers, constant per partition.

settlement.description: Whether this item is settled as of `completeThrough`.
Whether this item is settled as of `completeThrough`.

category.description: The authority whose contiguous fact sequence this frontier describes. Not a priced category: memory and compute share one.

completeThrough.description: The answer contains every matching fact at or below this sequence. Pinned on the first page and reported unchanged on every later page.

includesThrough.description: No fact above this sequence is present in the answer. Per page.

projectedSequence.description: Facts folded into the query projection.

serviceThrough.description: Service time the authority has observed through, when any fact has been admitted.

stallReason.description: Why the fold stopped, present exactly when `state` is `stalled`. A stalled frontier is the honest signal; a lag is not a stall.

stalledAt.description: The sequence the fold stopped at, present exactly when `state` is `stalled`.

state.description: Whether the fold is advancing or parked.

settlement.description: Whether this item is settled as of `completeThrough`.

frontiers.description: Pipeline frontiers, one per authority the query touched.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token. Never present for `bucket: total`: a partial total is a wrong number, so an over-budget total is refused instead of paged.

bucket.description: The time grain to answer at.

limit.description: Page size. Absent means 25. Above the maximum the request is refused, never clamped: a caller silently given fewer items than it asked for cannot tell a short page from the end of a collection.

timeRange.description: The service-time window, aligned to whole `bucket` grains in UTC. A misaligned range is refused, never widened. A range longer than 400 days is refused.

settlement.description: Whether this item is settled as of `completeThrough`.

apiUrl.description: The regional host this workspace answers on.

generationId.description: The exact retained generation that answered.

resumed.description: Whether this call first resumed the suspended generation.

organizationId.description: The organization the state comes from.
